items.title: Splunk认证绕过可未授权执行SPL
items.title_zh: Splunk认证绕过可未授权执行SPL
items.summary_zh: 未认证者利用RapidDiag空共享密钥绕过认证，以已认证身份执行任意SPL，读取或操控数据
items.affected: Splunk(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 升级至10.6.1等厂商修复版本
items.repro_note: 未授权调用RapidDiag任务收集接口，使用空共享密钥认证
items.description: In Splunk Enterprise versions below 10.6.1, 10.4.5, 10.2.9, 10.0.12, and 9.4.17, an unauthenticated user could run arbitrary Search Processing Language (SPL) searches through RapidDiag task collection as an authenticated user. The vulnerability is possible because Splunk Enterprise accepts an empty shared secret when it authenticates RapidDiag task-collection requests.

items.title: Splunk SOAR代码注入RCE
items.summary_zh: 高权限用户经App Wizard注入连接器代码，以SOAR进程权限执行命令
items.affected: Splunk(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.repro_note: 登录后进入App Wizard，在连接器标识中注入代码并执行Playbook
items.impact_scope: SOAR自动化平台，高权限用户可RCE
items.description: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user that holds a role with the Apps edit, Containers edit, and Playbooks execute permissions could use the App Wizard to execute arbitrary code as the user account that runs Splunk SOAR. This could compromise the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the Splunk SOAR instance. The vulnerability exists because the App Wizard does not validate user-supplied identifiers before incorporating them into generated connector code.

items.title: IBM Guardium反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可向SharePoint Tap组件发送恶意序列化数据，执行任意代码
items.action_zh: 升级Guardium Data Protection至修复版本
items.repro_note: 未授权向SharePoint Tap组件发送恶意序列化载荷
items.impact_scope: 数据安全审计设备，内网高价值目标
items.description: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to insecure deserialization in the SharePoint Tap MulticastTransceiver component. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to execute arbitrary code on the affected system.

items.title: Flyto2 Core路径遍历致RCE
items.summary_zh: 可执行模块或配方者利用路径遍历写入沙箱外文件，覆盖代码/启动项并获取主机代码执行
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级Flyto2 Core并限制模块/配方执行权限
items.repro_note: 调用模块/配方功能，在输出路径使用../写入沙箱外
items.impact_scope: 自动化/AI工作流内核，沙箱逃逸
items.description: Flyto2 Core is an execution kernel for automation and AI-agent workflows. A caller able to execute modules or recipes can therefore write attacker-controlled content outside the configured sandbox, potentially overwriting application code, recipes, startup files, scheduled-task files, or authorization files and gaining code execution on the host.

items.title: Guardium edge控制器SQL注入
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者可向edge-controller注入SQL，访问或修改敏感数据库信息
items.action_zh: 升级Guardium Data Protection修复版本
items.repro_note: 未授权请求edge-controller参数，构造SQL注入语句
items.impact_scope: 数据安全设备，敏感数据库信息
items.description: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to SQL injection in the edge-controller component. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this vulnerability to access or modify sensitive database information.

items.title: Etherpad未授权任意文件读取
items.summary_zh: 未认证远程攻击者经expressPreSession与核心伪插件路径遍历，读取Etherpad进程可访问任意文件
cwe_labels: 路径遍历/任意文件读取
items.action_zh: 升级Etherpad修复版本并限制文件权限
items.repro_note: 未授权访问expressPreSession相关路由，构造路径遍历读取文件
items.impact_scope: 协作编辑服务，可能泄露配置密钥
items.description: On POSIX systems the sanitizer correctly treats backslashes as ordinary filename bytes, but the later conversion turns encoded backslash-separated parent-directory segments into traversal components without revalidation or containment. The expressPreSession registration and the always-present ep_etherpad-lite core pseudo-plugin make this path reachable without credentials, allowing a remote attacker to read any file available to the Etherpad process.
